name: Nathalie Loiseau - § 23 - Am 12
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 23. Welcomes the steps taken by some Member States, including Germany, Cyprus and Denmark, to facilitate or resume returns to Syria; calls on other Member States to take similar steps to accelerate the return of Syrian asylum seekers and holders of temporary residence permits; opposes ‘go-and-see’ schemes that allow Syrian beneficiaries of international protection to visit Syria while guaranteeing that their protection status will remain unaffected; stresses that voluntary travel to the country from which protection was sought may call into question the continued need for that protection;
